# PixelKit — Free, 100% Client-Side Image & PDF Studio
> Free online image compressor, converter, resizer, and aspect-ratio cropper running locally in browser WebAssembly and Web Workers without server uploads.

## Core Capabilities
- Exact Kilobyte & Megabyte Budget Targeting: Binary search compression to Max Size, Exact Size, or Range (20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, etc.).
- Universal Format Conversion: Client-side conversion across JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, iPhone HEIC, SVG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, and multi-page PDF documents.
- Integrated Crop Studio: Aspect ratio presets (Passport 3.5x4.5, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, custom), rotation, and flip.
- High-DPI SVG Vector Scaling: 1x to 4x (96 to 600 DPI) vector rasterization to transparent PNG.
- PDF Tools: Merge multiple images/scans into a single compact PDF, or extract PDF pages to JPG/PNG.
- Zero Server Uploads: 100% private, files processed strictly on client device via Canvas API and Web Workers, runs offline as a PWA, no accounts, no subscriptions, no ads, no watermarks.
